# `hyperstac-environments`

Discover physical-radius environments from saved HyPERSTAC patch embeddings

- Wrapper: [`job_hyperstac_environments.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_hyperstac_environments.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-analysis`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.hyperstac_environments`

## Inputs

- HyPERSTAC embeddings, metrics, sensitivity and ROI-case mapping

## Outputs

- Separate environment AnnData, radius graphs, GMM models, summaries and stability

## Configuration

- general, hyperstac, hyperstac_environments, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl hyperstac-environments
```
